votes.motion: Transfer $520,000 from Free Cash to the FY2026 Snow Removal Expense line to cover operating deficits
votes.quote: vice-chair moore moved to recommend approval of article 9: that the town transfer from free cash the sum of $520,000 to the fy2026 "snow removal expense" line to cover fiscal year 2026 operating deficits. seconded by clerk emkey. call for the vote: five-aye. the motion passed unanimously (5-0-0).

votes.motion: Fund the first year of the Collective Bargaining Agreement dated July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2029 with PFFM Local 5369, Professional Firefighters Union
